messages:
maya: Heads-up — started a canary for the new sampling-weights config on meter-ingest (10% tenants). Noticed invoice-preview diffs in the console for a few accounts.
sam: which diffs? preview vs final or preview vs previous-preview?
maya: preview vs previous-preview primarily. Small token deltas but some customers see +30%-ish for short bursts.
lee: likely due to the new prefix-aggregation change. Sampling-weight now applied before route enrichment, so short sessions lose the cached prefix credits.
ana: @maya can you paste the config you rolled out? also pls add tenant ids for a couple of affected previews.
maya: sure — config snippet below:
```
{
  "sampling_version": "v2",
  "default_weight": 0.1,
  "route_overrides": {"interactive": 0.6, "batch": 0.05}
}
```
maya: affected tenant examples: t-1293, t-7721 (internal test), t-payg-44
sam: ah that route_override looks aggressive for interactive. Does the ingest pipeline apply weight pre- or post-fingerprint?
lee: current code applies it at the acceptor stage (pre-fingerprint) to reduce write pressure. That means downstream dedupe and prefix caching don't see the sampled requests.
ana: Console preview computes invoice using post-aggregate snapshots. If sampling happens before dedupe we would undercount retained prefixes. That explains dips, but why are some previews higher?
maya: higher previews came from tenants with many tiny ephemeral sessions — sampling removed noise from routing, but the per-route allocation algorithm then redistributed credits to remaining tokens, so per-tenant unit price bumped.
sam: so two orthogonal effects: lost cache benefits (lower counts) and redistribution of billing buckets (higher effective charges). We need to align metrics.
lee: proposal: switch sampling to post-enrichment (after fingerprint) for canary, keep acceptor sampling as backstop. That keeps write pressure control but preserves billing determinism for previews.
ana: from UX side we should flag canary previews with a badge: "Sampling applied — preview may differ from final invoice" and include a toggle to view pre/post-sampling totals.
billing-bot: [automated] Ingest sampler canary rolled at 2024-11-02T14:31:16Z for 10% tenants. Observability knobs: sampler.latency, sampler.drop_rate, invoice_preview.delta
maya: can we add sampling metadata to the invoice-preview event? a small field like "sample_applied": "pre-enrich|post-enrich|none" so frontend can show a tooltip.
sam: +1. also include the sampling_weight used and route_tag so we can correlate.
lee: implementable — quick patch to metering-producer to emit sample_meta in the billing_event envelope. Will target a patch and shadow build this afternoon.
maya: I'll pause the canary until patch + console flag done. Will post new canary window when ready. :handshake:
ana: thanks — I'll draft a small console copy change and a telemetry card in the dashboard to show preview vs final and sample_meta.
billing-bot: [automated] New ticket created: MET-9873 "Emit sample_meta on billing_event and console preview badge" assigned to lee. ETA 2d.
sam: small note: make sure query pre-aggregations used by invoice-preview UI accept the new field (we don't want scans). Consider embedding sample_meta into the aggregation keys.
lee: noted. I’ll coordinate with infra to ensure the aggregation schema migration is backward compatible.
maya: cool. tagging @ana for docs follow-up once we finalize UX text.
ana: on it. will keep copy short and explain why customers might see preview variance. :memo:
maya: thanks all — will unpause when patch and dashboard flag are live.
